title: The Idiot
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
summary: Prince Myshkin returns to Russia after treatment abroad, a kind, trusting man in a society that does not know what to do with him. He is drawn into the rivalries around a beautiful, troubled woman.
readIf: you like long, character-driven classics about goodness, morality and love going wrong.
skipIf: you want a quick read, or you find nineteenth-century talk-heavy novels tiring.

pairings.reason: Dostoevsky's tighter, darker moral drama, with a plot that moves faster.
Another Russian classic about love, society and what happens when feeling meets convention.
A modern novel built around an unusually sincere character at odds with the world.
